# Live2D Cubism Core for Web

This directory is reserved for the official Live2D Cubism Core runtime used by the PCAI Live2D prototype.

Expected runtime file:

- `live2dcubismcore.min.js`

Source package used for this prototype: Cubism SDK for Web 5-r.5.
